title: Certifying Emphysema Densitometry from Thick-Slice CT by Residual Arbitration
title_zh: 用残差仲裁为厚层 CT 的肺气肿定量结果出具证书
method_name: ARC-CT (Arbitrated Reconstruction with Certificates for CT)
hook: On real 5 mm chest CT, essentially all of the emphysema-index accuracy that restoration networks gain from real-paired fine-tuning is carried by a single global attenuation offset — and that offset is detectable from the thick series alone, because slab averaging preserves slab means for every slice-profile width. A restoration pipeline that identifies its own acquisition operator per scan can therefore decompose its data-consistency residual into a displacement term and a structural term, and refuse to report a densitometric value whose accuracy came from the displacement term.
abstract_draft: Emphysema is quantified from chest CT by a threshold statistic of the lung attenuation histogram — the percentage of voxels below -950 HU (LAA-950) and the 15th percentile of lung attenuation — but most archived chest CT is reconstructed at 5-8 mm slice thickness, where slab averaging biases both. Deep restoration of thick-slice CT is now clinically validated on diagnostic endpoints (openalex:W4404646478) and benchmarked on real 1 mm/5 mm pairs (dblp:journals/corr/abs-2206-06253), yet both are optimised and judged as images. Because the map from a reconstruction to a threshold statistic is many-to-one, a restoration that DISPLACES the histogram and one that RECOVERS its low-attenuation tail are indistinguishable to every objective and metric currently used: in our preliminary run on real 5 mm data, the entire LAA-950 gain from real-pair fine-tuning was reproduced by changing a single output-bias scalar by -12.2 HU, while the reconstructed histogram stayed too narrow. ARC-CT decomposes the pipeline into three solvers that exchange a typed, machine-checkable artifact instead of activations: a non-learned solver identifies the through-plane acquisition per scan (effective slice width, noise, unexplained-residual fraction), the network reconstructs conditioned on that identification, and a moment-based solver decomposes the data-consistency residual into a displacement term and a structural term — the displacement term being invariant to the width estimate because slab averaging preserves slab means. The arbiter certifies, flags or abstains per scan, with no thin-slice reference. Falsification: on held-out real pairs, the displacement term must separate a genuinely improved model from a displacement-improved one, and freezing the operator identification at the nominal width must return LAA-950 concordance to the un-adapted regime. Expected outcome: densitometric values from restored thick-slice CT that carry evidence, rather than accuracy of unknown provenance.

motivation.problem_framing:
Quantitative CT densitometry is a threshold statistic: LAA-950 counts the fraction of lung voxels below -950 HU, and Perc15 reads the 15th percentile of the same histogram. Thick-slice acquisition averages along the through-plane axis, which narrows that histogram and therefore biases both numbers — an effect measured repeatedly across slice thickness, kernel and dose (openalex:W4404646478 for the restoration side; the diagnostic-side literature documents the bias but stops there). Two research lines respond. The restoration line synthesises thin slices from thick ones and is now validated multi-centre on DIAGNOSTIC endpoints (openalex:W4404646478) with a real-paired benchmark that exposes a simulated-versus-real domain gap (dblp:journals/corr/abs-2206-06253). The densitometry line leaves the image alone and corrects the scalar: kernel conversion to a reference protocol (openalex:W4407122143), or statistical correction of the density summary for volume, noise and inter-scanner bias.

Neither line can answer the question a trial actually asks. Because the map from a reconstruction to a threshold statistic is many-to-one, a global attenuation displacement and a genuine recovery of the low-attenuation tail produce the same LAA-950 and are indistinguishable to a voxel-wise or perceptual objective, to PSNR/SSIM, and to a reader study. This is not hypothetical: in our preliminary run, fine-tuning a densitometry-guarded restoration model on real 1 mm/5 mm pairs improved LAA-950 mean absolute error from 0.56 to 0.41 percentage points and concordance from 0.47 to 0.84 — and a tensor-level comparison showed that the ONLY weight that moved beyond float32 noise was the output bias, by -12.2 HU. Replacing that single scalar in the un-fine-tuned model reproduced the entire gain, while the reconstruction's lung standard deviation stayed at 54.9 HU against the reference's 58.6 HU.

The structural reason is that the reconstruction's own physics is never held accountable. The acquisition operator is assumed — nominally 5 mm, when a fit on 50 real pairs gives an effective width of 6.25 mm — so the data-consistency residual conflates operator error with reconstruction error, and a displacement large enough to move the endpoint hides inside it. The model-based lines that do relax the operator assumption (arxiv:2503.21501v1, arxiv:2403.04847v2, semanticscholar:0d3795c98a2a83d53704e5965e08461bc452dfc1) recover physical parameters for their own sake and never ask what a per-scan estimate must be accountable to, while the safety-oriented line bounds edits in the image domain (arxiv:2605.16458v1), which neither implies nor detects a bound on the functional that is actually read.
motivation.why_now: Three things converged inside the last twelve months. First, thick-slice restoration crossed from image quality into clinical validation (openalex:W4404646478, npj Digital Medicine 2024), so its outputs are now candidates for measurement, not only for viewing. Second, the field acquired the instruments to name this failure: a cross-modality benchmark showing that deployed reconstruction networks collapse under operator mismatch (arxiv:2603.04538v1, 2026-03), and a physics-informed benchmark for detecting and grading CT degradation (arxiv:2605.16431v1, 2026-05) — both measure the disease, neither closes the loop back into the reconstruction or into a clinical quantity. Third, the agentic turn reached medical imaging (arxiv:2605.22208v2, arxiv:2606.29763v1, 2026), which makes it timely to ask what a multi-solver decomposition must own to be more than pipeline orchestration. Meanwhile the only public real-paired 1 mm/5 mm chest CT benchmark was released in full (dblp:journals/corr/abs-2206-06253), so the sim-versus-real question can now be answered on public data instead of behind institutional walls.

why_prior_stopped.what_they_did: Built and multi-centre-validated a convolution-transformer network that synthesises 1 mm chest CT from 5 mm input, showing improved reader diagnosis and improved downstream AI performance.
why_prior_stopped.what_they_did_not_do: Never evaluated a densitometric endpoint — LAA-950, Perc15 and the lung attenuation distribution appear nowhere in the paper — so nothing distinguishes a reconstruction that restores the histogram from one that relocates it.
why_prior_stopped.structural_reason_they_stopped: Missing measurement: their success criterion is diagnostic, and a diagnostic criterion is insensitive to a global attenuation offset that moves a threshold count.

why_prior_stopped.venue_year: International Conference on Medical Image Computing and Computer-Assisted Intervention 2022
why_prior_stopped.what_they_did: Released the first real-paired 1 mm/5 mm chest CT benchmark and demonstrated that models trained on simulated degradation transfer poorly to real thick series.
why_prior_stopped.what_they_did_not_do: Left the gap as a PSNR/SSIM deficit without attributing it to a physical cause or attaching a clinical quantity to it.
why_prior_stopped.structural_reason_they_stopped: Missing mechanism: the benchmark has no per-scan estimate of the acquisition, so the observed gap cannot be decomposed into operator error and reconstruction error.

why_prior_stopped.what_they_did: Constructed a cross-modality benchmark quantifying how far reconstruction networks fall when the assumed forward operator deviates from the physical one.
why_prior_stopped.what_they_did_not_do: Did not feed the mismatch estimate back into reconstruction, and did not connect it to any downstream measurement whose bias the mismatch must explain.
why_prior_stopped.structural_reason_they_stopped: Missing mechanism: the benchmark's unit of analysis is the network's image error, so a mismatch that matters only through a functional of the output has no place to be reported.

why_prior_stopped.what_they_did: Inferred image and measurement operator jointly under a generative prior over operators, so a blind inverse problem can be solved without calibration.
why_prior_stopped.what_they_did_not_do: Did not construct the projection of the residual onto the direction that moves a downstream functional, so an operator error and an image offset remain exchangeable inside one posterior.
why_prior_stopped.structural_reason_they_stopped: Missing measurement: with no functional to defend, there is no reason to privilege the mean direction of the residual over any other.

why_prior_stopped.what_they_did: Argued that a restoration model in a safety-sensitive setting is not free to rewrite its input, and constrained the magnitude, location and stability of its edits.
why_prior_stopped.what_they_did_not_do: Bounded edits in the image domain only; a small, spatially diffuse, entirely admissible edit is exactly what moves a -950 HU threshold count.
why_prior_stopped.structural_reason_they_stopped: Missing assumption-relaxation: the safety criterion is stated over voxels, not over the functional the clinician reads, so the bound cannot be transferred to the measurement.

why_prior_stopped.what_they_did: Converted reconstruction kernels across hospitals to one reference setting and showed the resulting emphysema extent correlates better with clinical parameters.
why_prior_stopped.what_they_did_not_do: Harmonised the kernel only, left slice thickness untouched, and fitted one global mapping rather than estimating what the current scan's acquisition actually was.
why_prior_stopped.structural_reason_they_stopped: Missing tool: without a per-scan estimate of the acquisition there is nothing to harmonise TOWARD except a reference protocol that archived data does not have.

why_prior_stopped.what_they_did: Coupled Bayesian spectral deconvolution with an expert-reasoning loop that revises the physical model when automated deconvolution fails on unknown background or noise.
why_prior_stopped.what_they_did_not_do: Bound neither the reasoner's proposals to a data-consistency contract nor the loop to a quantity of record, so a disagreement between reasoner and measurement has no adjudicator.
why_prior_stopped.structural_reason_they_stopped: Missing mechanism: the loop optimises the fit of a 1-D model, and there is no functional whose correctness the revised model must still defend.

why_prior_stopped.what_they_did: Built a self-evolving multimodal-LLM restoration agent that selects tools and their application order for coupled degradations, learning from past trajectories.
why_prior_stopped.what_they_did_not_do: Spent agency on tool selection over an existing restoration toolbox; no agent owns a physical estimand, nothing binds the plan to the observation, and no measured quantity has to survive it.
why_prior_stopped.structural_reason_they_stopped: Missing assumption-relaxation: with the degradation model outside the agents' remit, the plan can only be judged by the restored image, which is the very criterion that cannot see a displacement.

motivation.what_changes_when_gap_closes: A densitometric value read off a restored thick-slice volume becomes reportable evidence rather than a number of unknown provenance: each scan carries a per-scan statement of how much of its LAA-950 is attributable to a global attenuation displacement and how much of the observation the identified acquisition cannot explain, so a multi-centre study can decide scan-by-scan whether a value may be pooled instead of relying on protocol paperwork. It also makes the restoration literature cumulative in a way it currently is not — an effective slice width and an unexplained-residual fraction are comparable across papers, scanners and thicknesses, whereas a PSNR on a private cohort is not. Finally it gives the field a way to test, rather than assert, that a restoration recovered structure: any method claiming tail recovery can be asked for the same certificate.

core_claim: Because slab averaging preserves slab means for every slice-profile width, the mean direction of a reconstruction's data-consistency residual identifies a global attenuation displacement independently of the acquisition estimate — so a thick-slice restoration can state, per scan and without a thin-slice reference, whether its emphysema index is carried by a displacement of the attenuation histogram or by evidence the measurement actually supports.

sub_claims.statement: On real 5 mm chest CT, the LAA-950 improvement obtained by fine-tuning a densitometry-guarded restoration model on real pairs is reproduced by changing one scalar — the network's output bias — leaving the reconstructed lung histogram's width unchanged.
sub_claims.supports_which_aspect: the empirical reveal in the hook; motivates why a threshold statistic needs a provenance statement

sub_claims.statement: The displacement term of the residual, computed over the eroded interior of the lung set, is invariant to the operator width estimate (measured spread 0.04 HU across 4-10 mm on a real pair) while the un-eroded version varies by 9.4 HU over the same range.
sub_claims.supports_which_aspect: the identifiability pivot: what makes the certificate meaningful under an unknown acquisition

sub_claims.statement: The effective through-plane width of a real 5 mm series is identifiable per scan from the series itself (median 6.25 mm over 50 real pairs, versus the 5.00 mm nominal value), and conditioning the reconstruction on it is separable from using it to audit the reconstruction.
sub_claims.supports_which_aspect: the audit leg — the fixed-operator assumption is false and its relaxation is testable

sub_claims.statement: A per-scan certify/flag/abstain verdict computable without any thin-slice reference separates a genuinely improved model from a displacement-improved one on held-out real pairs.
sub_claims.supports_which_aspect: the deployment claim: the verdict leg, and the falsification's outcome metric

key_equations.description: The through-plane acquisition model: a normalised Gaussian slice-sensitivity profile of full-width-half-maximum w applied along z, followed by an average over r thin slices per thick slice.
key_equations.description_zh: 层厚采集模型：沿 z 方向做归一化高斯层敏感度卷积（半高全宽 w），再对每 r 层薄层取平均得到一层厚层。

key_equations.description: The operator solver: a grid fit of the effective width from the observed thick series itself, plus the fraction of the observation the fitted physics cannot explain.
key_equations.description_zh: 算子求解器：直接从观测到的厚层序列网格拟合有效层厚，并给出该物理模型无法解释的观测占比。

key_equations.description: The displacement term and the invariance it rests on: over the eroded interior L_e of the lung set, the slab average preserves the mean for every width, so a global attenuation offset is identified independently of the width estimate.
key_equations.description_zh: 位移项及其依据的不变性：在肺区集合的腐蚀内部 L_e 上，厚层平均对任意层厚都保持均值，因此全局 HU 偏移的识别与层厚估计无关。

key_equations.description: The arbiter: a feasibility verdict on the certificate rather than a score, naming the dominant violated term when it flags.
key_equations.description_zh: 仲裁器：对证书做可行性判定而非打分，判为 flagged 时给出主导违反项。

key_equations.description: The single new training term: the displacement penalty, which bills the free lunch the trajectory guardrail otherwise takes.
key_equations.description_zh: 训练侧唯一新增项：位移惩罚，用来对轨迹护栏原本可以白拿的那部分收益计价。

method_flow.high_level_pipeline: A thick-slice chest CT series arrives with no phantom, no reference protocol and no thin-slice counterpart. A non-learned operator solver first asks what acquisition could have produced it, fitting an effective through-plane width and noise level from the series itself and reporting how much of the observation that fitted physics cannot explain. The reconstruction network is then conditioned on that identification rather than on a nominal slice width, and returns a 1 mm volume. A moment-based densitometry solver takes the reconstruction back through the identified acquisition and splits the disagreement with the observation into a global displacement term — the one direction slab averaging leaves invariant, so it is readable no matter what width was fitted — and a structural remainder, adding a protocol-calibrated tail-recovery term when a calibration for this protocol exists. The arbiter reads the resulting certificate and returns certify, flag or abstain together with the emphysema index, so the number leaves the pipeline with its provenance attached.

steps.title: Build real thin/thick pairs and a matched simulated arm
steps.what_changes: Turns raw paired NIfTI volumes into z-aligned, integer-ratio .npy pairs plus a per-case audit row, and creates a simulated arm from the same anatomy with a KNOWN operator.
steps.why_this_step: The confound-isolating separation the audit leg owes needs two arms that differ only in whether the acquisition is known.
steps.linked_falsification: supplies the held-out real pairs the falsification experiment runs on

steps.title: Identify the acquisition per scan (operator solver)
steps.what_changes: Fits the effective through-plane width by grid search over 2.00-12.00 mm and estimates the through-plane noise, reporting the unexplained-residual fraction and whether the fit sits at a grid endpoint.
steps.why_this_step: Every certificate term is computed under this estimate; a nominal width both hides a displacement inside the residual and mis-conditions the network.
steps.linked_falsification: the negative control freezes this step at the nominal 5.00 mm
steps.input: thick volume y, current thin estimate x_tilde
steps.output: (w_hat, sigma_hat, rho) + the full fit profile

steps.title: Condition the reconstruction on the identified acquisition
steps.what_changes: Replaces the constant nominal-width conditioning of the network's identification module with (w_hat, sigma_hat), which changes the reconstructed volume and therefore every statistic read off it.
steps.why_this_step: Separates identification-for-conditioning from identification-for-auditing, which ablation (c) then measures.
steps.linked_falsification: ablation (c) removes this conditioning while keeping the certificate

steps.title: Fit the tail-recovery calibration on training pairs only
steps.what_changes: Regresses the thin-slice through-plane lung variance on quantities observable at inference and measures the held-out residual spread, refusing to ship the term when the relation carries no information.
steps.why_this_step: The closed-form attenuation identity is false by an order of magnitude on real data, so the tail-recovery evidence must be empirical and scoped.
steps.linked_falsification: the tail-recovery term is one of the quantities the falsification compares across arms
steps.output: fitted relation f, its residual spread sigma_v, the protocol tag

steps.title: Compute the certificate (densitometry solver)
steps.what_changes: Builds the eroded interior of the lung set, computes the displacement term, the structural remainder and — when calibrated — the tail-recovery term, emitting ABSTAIN on an empty set and UNAVAILABLE without a calibration.
steps.why_this_step: This is the typed artifact that crosses the boundary between the learned and the physical parts of the pipeline.
steps.linked_falsification: the displacement term is the load-bearing variable of the falsification

steps.title: Validate the estimators on a known-perfect reconstruction
steps.what_changes: Runs the certificate with the TRUE thin volume in place of the reconstruction on held-out pairs; any term that does not return its null value is reported as estimator bias before any model claim is made.
steps.why_this_step: This check is what exposed the two defects in the first version of the mechanism, and it is cheap enough to be mandatory.
steps.linked_falsification: establishes the null values against which the falsification's arms are read
steps.output: per-term bias floor (e.g. the -0.55 HU displacement floor measured on a real pair)

steps.title: Add the displacement penalty and re-train
steps.what_changes: Adds lambda_delta |delta_hat| to the existing composite loss; the gradient flows through the identified acquisition into the network and shifts the reconstruction's lung mean, changing the LAA-950 count it produces.
steps.why_this_step: It bills the one direction the trajectory guardrail could otherwise use to buy densitometric accuracy for free.

steps.title: Arbitrate and gate the reported value
steps.what_changes: Implements certify / flag / abstain as a pure function of the certificate and the three thresholds, emitting the verdict, the dominant violated term and the gated densitometric value.
steps.why_this_step: Converts a disagreement between assumed physics and observation into a statement about the number a clinician reads.
steps.linked_falsification: the verdict is the per-scan output whose separation power the experiment tests

steps.title: Evaluate five arms under one harness
steps.what_changes: Computes endpoint metrics and the certificate jointly for the trilinear baseline, the restoration model, its real-pair fine-tuned version, its output-bias-only recalibration and ARC-CT; no arm may report an endpoint without its certificate.
steps.why_this_step: The bias-only arm is the positive control that makes the hook's claim checkable.
steps.linked_falsification: this harness IS the falsification experiment
steps.input: all trained arms, held-out real pairs

steps.title: Ablate the decomposition
steps.what_changes: Freezes the operator solver at the nominal width, zeroes the displacement penalty, removes the conditioning while keeping the certificate, and sweeps the erosion radius over 4-12 voxels.
steps.why_this_step: Isolates the marginal contribution of each solver, which is what separates a decomposition from an assembly.
steps.linked_falsification: the frozen-operator run is the falsification's negative control

steps.title: Repeat at 8 mm without retuning
steps.what_changes: Runs the whole pipeline at r = 8 on simulated 8 mm slabs and checks that the operator solver returns a wider width and the thresholds still apply.
steps.why_this_step: Cross-thickness transfer is the practical reason the operator is identified rather than assumed.
steps.linked_falsification: an out-of-training-regime check on the same load-bearing variable

steps.title: Report certificate distributions per arm
steps.what_changes: Contrasts the certificate distribution on the simulated arm (operator known) against the real arm (operator identified), which is the confound-isolating separation the audit leg promised.
steps.why_this_step: Shows whether the residual the identified operator cannot explain is what separates simulated from real performance.
steps.linked_falsification: supports the mechanism claim beyond the single load-bearing variable

method_flow.design_reasoning_echo: The design starts from a measured failure rather than from an architecture: on real thick-slice data the apparent densitometric gain of real-pair fine-tuning was carried by a single output-bias scalar, which means the objective could buy the endpoint without buying the evidence. The naive fix — add a data-consistency loss under the nominal operator and report its residual — fails because the nominal operator is wrong (5.00 mm assumed against 6.25 mm fitted, with 12.8% of the thick signal unexplained), so the residual conflates operator error with reconstruction error and the displacement hides inside it. The mechanism therefore identifies the operator per scan and then decomposes the residual along the direction that moves a threshold count. Two design decisions are deliberate: the tail-recovery term is report-only and never trained on, because a model can satisfy a variance target by injecting through-plane noise; and the reconstruction is NOT projected onto exact data consistency, because doing so would hard-code the fitted operator into the output and make the certificate vacuous by construction. The mechanism also stays off three occupied positions in the field's lineage: deconvolving with a phantom-measured profile, harmonising to a reference kernel or protocol, and letting a reasoning agent select restoration tools.

plain_motivation_en:
Doctors measure emphysema on a chest CT scan by counting how many lung voxels are darker (less dense) than -950 Hounsfield Units, a number called LAA-950, and by reading the 15th percentile of the lung density distribution, called Perc15. Both are just readings off a histogram of densities. Most hospitals, however, store CT reconstructed in thick slices (5 mm or 8 mm) instead of thin ones (1 mm), and a thick slice is an average over the tissue inside it. Averaging narrows the histogram, so both numbers come out wrong.

One research line trains neural networks to turn thick slices back into thin ones; this now demonstrably helps doctors read the scan. Another line leaves the picture alone and statistically corrects the number afterwards. Neither can answer the question that matters for a clinical trial, and the reason is arithmetic: many different reconstructions give exactly the same LAA-950. In particular, a network that simply shifts the whole density histogram down until the count comes out right looks identical, on every image-quality measure and to every reader, to a network that genuinely restored the dark low-density regions that averaging erased.

This is not a hypothetical worry. In our own preliminary run, fine-tuning a restoration model on real thick/thin scan pairs improved its emphysema numbers a lot - and when we compared the weights before and after, the ONLY thing that had really changed was a single number, the output bias, by about -12 HU. Copying that one number into the un-tuned model reproduced the whole improvement, while the restored image's density spread stayed too narrow. The deeper cause is that the network's assumption about how the thick slice was formed is never checked: it assumes a 5 mm averaging window when a fit on 50 real scan pairs says the real window behaves like 6.25 mm. Under a wrong assumption, the mismatch between the network's output and the scan it was given mixes two different errors together, and a shift big enough to change the diagnosis hides inside it.
plain_motivation_zh:
医生在胸部 CT 上量肺气肿，靠的是数一数肺内有多少体素比 -950 HU 更「黑」（密度更低），这个比例叫 LAA-950；另一个常用指标 Perc15 则是肺密度分布的第 15 百分位数。两者本质上都是从密度直方图上读出来的数。可是医院里存下来的大多是 5 mm 或 8 mm 的厚层重建，而不是 1 mm 薄层——厚层就是把一段组织平均掉，平均会把直方图压窄，于是这两个数都会偏。

一条研究路线是训练神经网络把厚层「还原」成薄层，现在已经证明能帮助医生读片；另一条路线不动图像，只在事后对那个数做统计校正。两条路都回答不了临床试验真正关心的问题，原因是算术上的：很多不同的重建会给出完全相同的 LAA-950。特别是，一个只把整张密度直方图整体往下挪、直到计数对上的网络，在所有图像质量指标上、在所有读片医生眼里，都和一个真正把平均掉的低密度区域找回来的网络长得一模一样。

这不是空想。我们自己的预实验里，用真实厚薄层配对去微调一个重建模型，肺气肿指标确实大幅变好——但把微调前后的权重逐张量比对后发现，真正变了的只有一个数：输出偏置，大约 -12 HU。把这一个数抄回没微调的模型，全部收益就复现了，而重建图像的密度离散度依然偏窄。更深一层的原因是：网络对「厚层是怎么形成的」这个假设从来没被检验过——它假设 5 mm 的平均窗口，而在 50 对真实配对上拟合出来的有效窗口相当于 6.25 mm。假设错了，网络输出与实际扫描之间的不一致就把两种误差混在一起，足以改变结论的整体偏移就藏在里面。

plain_method_steps_en.what_to_do: Prepare matched scan pairs: line up each hospital thick-slice series with its own thin-slice reconstruction, and separately make a simulated thick series from the thin one where you KNOW exactly how it was made.
plain_method_steps_en.why_this_makes_sense: You need two situations that differ only in whether the averaging process is known, otherwise you can never tell whether a failure came from the physics or from the network.

plain_method_steps_en.what_to_do: Ask the scan how it was made: search over candidate averaging widths (2 to 12 mm) for the one that best explains the thick series, and record how much of the scan that best explanation still cannot account for.
plain_method_steps_en.why_this_makes_sense: Everything downstream is judged against this estimate; if you assume the nominal width instead, the assumption error and the network error get mixed together.

plain_method_steps_en.what_to_do: Tell the network what you found: feed the estimated width and noise level into the network instead of a fixed nominal value.
plain_method_steps_en.why_this_makes_sense: The network should reconstruct the volume implied by the acquisition this scan actually had, not by the one written on the box.

plain_method_steps_en.what_to_do: Calibrate the 'did it restore texture' yardstick on training scans only, and measure how noisy that yardstick is on scans it never saw.
plain_method_steps_en.why_this_makes_sense: The textbook formula for how much texture averaging removes is off by an order of magnitude on real data, so this yardstick has to be measured rather than derived, and it must carry the honest error bar that comes with that.

plain_method_steps_en.what_to_do: Compute the certificate: put the reconstruction back through the estimated averaging, compare it with the actual thick scan, and split the disagreement into (a) a plain overall shift, (b) everything else, and (c) the texture yardstick.
plain_method_steps_en.why_this_makes_sense: The overall shift is the part that fakes a good emphysema number, and it is the one part that can be read off no matter which averaging width was estimated.

plain_method_steps_en.what_to_do: Sanity-check the certificate on a scan whose answer you know: feed in the TRUE thin volume instead of a reconstruction and confirm each term returns its expected null value.
plain_method_steps_en.why_this_makes_sense: If the yardstick condemns a perfect answer, it is measuring your estimator's bias rather than the model's behaviour - this check caught exactly that twice while designing the method.

plain_method_steps_en.what_to_do: Train with the shift penalised: add the size of that overall shift to the training objective.
plain_method_steps_en.why_this_makes_sense: It removes the cheapest way for training to make the emphysema number look right without earning it.

plain_method_steps_en.what_to_do: Decide and gate: turn the certificate into one of three verdicts - certified, flagged (naming which part failed), or abstain - and attach it to the emphysema number.
plain_method_steps_en.why_this_makes_sense: A trial needs to know whether this scan's value may be pooled with the others, and that decision should come from the data, not from paperwork.

plain_method_steps_en.what_to_do: Compare five versions under one identical harness, each reporting both its emphysema numbers and its certificate.
plain_method_steps_en.why_this_makes_sense: One of the five is the un-tuned model with only its output bias corrected - if that alone matches the fine-tuned model, the whole argument of the paper is confirmed.

plain_method_steps_en.what_to_do: Remove one piece at a time: freeze the width estimate at the nominal value, switch off the shift penalty, remove the conditioning, and sweep how much the mask is shrunk.
plain_method_steps_en.why_this_makes_sense: This is what shows the decomposition is doing the work, rather than extra data or a longer training schedule.

plain_method_steps_en.what_to_do: Repeat everything for 8 mm slices without retuning anything.
plain_method_steps_en.why_this_makes_sense: If the width really is estimated rather than assumed, a thicker series should just report a wider width and keep working.

plain_method_steps_en.what_to_do: Report the certificate's distribution separately for simulated and real scans.
plain_method_steps_en.why_this_makes_sense: This shows directly how much of the simulated-to-real performance drop is explained by the part of the scan the estimated physics cannot account for.

plain_method_steps_zh.what_to_do: 准备配对数据：把每一例医院里的厚层序列和它自己的薄层重建对齐；另外再用薄层人工合成一份厚层，这份的生成方式是完全已知的。
plain_method_steps_zh.why_this_makes_sense: 你需要两种只在「生成过程是否已知」上有差别的情形，否则永远分不清失败是物理建模错了还是网络错了。

plain_method_steps_zh.what_to_do: 问扫描本身它是怎么来的：在 2 到 12 mm 的候选平均窗口里搜出最能解释该厚层序列的那个，并记录这个最优解释仍然解释不了的比例。
plain_method_steps_zh.why_this_makes_sense: 后面所有判断都以这个估计为准；如果直接用标称层厚，假设误差和网络误差就被混在一起了。

plain_method_steps_zh.what_to_do: 把结果告诉网络：用估计出来的层厚和噪声水平做条件输入，替换掉原来固定的标称值。
plain_method_steps_zh.why_this_makes_sense: 网络应该重建「这次扫描真实采集方式」所蕴含的体数据，而不是设备标签上写的那一个。

plain_method_steps_zh.what_to_do: 只在训练集上标定「是否真的把纹理找回来了」这把尺子，并在没见过的病例上测出这把尺子本身有多大误差。
plain_method_steps_zh.why_this_makes_sense: 教科书公式算出的纹理衰减量在真实数据上差了一个数量级，所以这把尺子必须实测而不是推导，并且要带上它应有的误差棒。

plain_method_steps_zh.what_to_do: 计算证书：把重建结果按估计出的平均方式再过一遍，与真实厚层比较，把不一致拆成 (a) 整体平移、(b) 其余结构残差、(c) 纹理尺子三部分。
plain_method_steps_zh.why_this_makes_sense: 整体平移正是那个能把肺气肿指标「做对」的假动作，而且无论层厚估计成多少，它都能被读出来。

plain_method_steps_zh.what_to_do: 拿已知答案的病例检验证书：把真实薄层直接当成「重建结果」送进去，确认每一项都回到它应有的零值。
plain_method_steps_zh.why_this_makes_sense: 如果这把尺子连完美答案都判不合格，那它量的是估计器自身的偏差而不是模型的行为——设计过程中这一步就抓出了两个这样的错误。

plain_method_steps_zh.what_to_do: 带着平移惩罚训练：把整体平移的绝对值加进训练目标。
plain_method_steps_zh.why_this_makes_sense: 这堵死了训练过程中「不劳而获」把指标做好看的最便宜那条路。

plain_method_steps_zh.what_to_do: 判定并把关：把证书变成三种结论之一——通过、标记（并指出是哪一项没过）、或弃权，并把结论附在肺气肿指标上。
plain_method_steps_zh.why_this_makes_sense: 临床试验需要知道这一例的数值能不能和其它例合并统计，而这个判断应该来自数据本身，而不是来自 protocol 文书。

plain_method_steps_zh.what_to_do: 在同一套评测流程下比较五个版本，每个版本都必须同时给出指标和证书。
plain_method_steps_zh.why_this_makes_sense: 其中一个版本是「只把输出偏置校正了」的原模型——如果它就能追平完整微调，本文的核心论断就被证实了。

plain_method_steps_zh.what_to_do: 逐个拆掉组件：把层厚估计冻结在标称值、关掉平移惩罚、去掉条件输入、扫描掩膜腐蚀半径。
plain_method_steps_zh.why_this_makes_sense: 这才能说明起作用的是这套分解，而不是更多数据或更长的训练。

plain_method_steps_zh.what_to_do: 在 8 mm 层厚上原样重跑一遍，不调任何超参。
plain_method_steps_zh.why_this_makes_sense: 如果层厚真的是估出来的而不是假设的，那么更厚的序列应该只是报出一个更大的层厚，然后照常工作。

plain_method_steps_zh.what_to_do: 分别报告合成臂与真实臂上的证书分布。
plain_method_steps_zh.why_this_makes_sense: 这能直接看出：合成到真实的性能落差，有多少是由「估计出的物理解释不了的那部分」造成的。

plain_method_modules_en.purpose_oneline: Work out, from the thick scan alone, how it was actually acquired, and say how much of it that explanation misses.
Turn the leftover disagreement into a small set of named numbers, one of which is readable no matter what acquisition was estimated.
Penalise the cheap shift during training, and at deployment attach a certify / flag / abstain verdict to the reported emphysema value.
Show the decomposition is what does the work, and that it survives a different slice thickness.

plain_method_modules_zh.purpose_oneline: 仅凭厚层扫描本身推断它到底是怎么采集的，并说明这个解释还漏掉了多少。
把剩下的不一致变成几个有名字的数，其中一个无论层厚估计成多少都能读出来。
训练时对整体平移计价，部署时给报告出去的肺气肿数值附上通过/标记/弃权的结论。
证明真正起作用的是这套分解，并且换一种层厚它依然成立。

falsification_prediction: Minimal experiment: on the RPLHR-CT real-paired chest CT benchmark, hold out the official validation split as a test set, train the restoration model in three arms — simulated-thick supervision only, real-pair fine-tuned, and ours (per-scan identified operator plus the displacement penalty) — and evaluate each on the SAME held-out real pairs, reporting LAA-950 MAE and concordance with the 1 mm reference, Perc15 MAE, and the certificate (delta_hat, rho_struct, s) per case. If the candidate works, LAA-950 concordance on the real arm rises relative to the simulated-supervision arm WHILE |delta_hat| stays small and the variance deficit s shrinks, whereas the real-pair fine-tuned arm reaches comparable concordance with a large |delta_hat| and an unchanged s — i.e. the two arms are separated by the certificate even though the endpoint metric alone does not distinguish them. The load-bearing variable is delta_hat, the lung-masked mean of the data-consistency residual. Negative control: ablate its producer by freezing the operator solver at the nominal width (w_hat := 5.00 mm) so delta_hat is computed under a mis-specified operator; the prediction is on the DOWNSTREAM outcome — LAA-950 concordance with the reference on the real arm falls back toward the un-fine-tuned regime and the certificate stops separating the arms, because the displacement term is then absorbed into rho. A second control randomises delta_hat's sign per batch during training (breaking the penalty while keeping its magnitude in the loss), which should remove the endpoint gain if the mechanism acts through the displacement direction rather than through extra regularisation. Positive control: a stripped-down arm that keeps the ORIGINAL network and only recalibrates its output bias by -delta_hat measured on a handful of real pairs — if that arm already matches the fine-tuned arm's endpoint metrics, the displacement explanation is confirmed as the operative mechanism of current real-pair fine-tuning, which is the reveal the hook claims.
compute_budget: ≈2 GPU-days total on a single 16 GB consumer GPU (RTX 5080): one training run of the 0.35 M-parameter 3D model is 20-40 min, and the campaign is ~40 runs (3 arms x 3 ablations x 3 seeds, plus the r = 8 repeat and threshold sweeps); the operator grid search adds ~40 blur-plus-pool forward passes per case, which is seconds. Data preparation (2 x 150 volumes through the pairing path) is ~1 CPU-hour x 4 processes. No paid API is used. Against the default envelope (80 GB-class GPUs, ~150 GPU-days) this is comfortable, and it is deliberately sized to run on hardware a hospital research group already owns.
what_step_was_missed: They construct a generative prior over measurement operators and infer the operator jointly with the image, but they never construct the projection of the resulting data-consistency residual onto the sub-space that moves a downstream functional — here, the mean direction, which slab averaging leaves invariant for every operator width and which therefore identifies a global attenuation displacement independently of the operator estimate. Without that construction the joint posterior can trade an operator error against an image offset with no observable signature, so nothing in their formulation can state whether a threshold statistic computed on the recovered image is supported by the measurement.

compute.rationale: GPU line ≈ 2 vs 1 GPU-day (200%) → infeasible. Overall (worse line) → infeasible.

data.rationale: Everything the mechanism needs is public and already downloaded: RPLHR-CT supplies 250 chest CT cases with REAL paired 1 mm and 5 mm reconstructions (CC-BY-4.0), and LIDC-IDRI/LUNA16 supply thin-slice volumes for scaling the simulated arm; no private or credentialed data is required for any claim in the falsification.

theoretical.rationale: The only load-bearing analytic statement is the mean-preservation property of a normalised blur followed by average pooling, together with the support condition under which it survives masking — both elementary, and both already checked numerically against a real pair rather than assumed.

engineering.rationale: The operator solver is a 41-point grid search over an existing differentiable forward operator, the certificate is a handful of masked moments, and the arbiter is a pure function; the only non-trivial engineering is the paired-data preparation, which is already implemented and run.

falsification.rationale: The experiment names its dataset split, its five arms, its outcome metric with direction, one load-bearing variable, a negative control that intervenes on that variable's producer and a positive control that is a single-scalar recalibration — all runnable on the hardware already in use.

differentiation_from_lit.delta: They construct a thick-to-thin mapping and validate that the restored volume changes reader and downstream-AI diagnostic outcomes; we construct, per scan and without a reference, a decomposition of the observation residual into an operator term, a displacement term and a structural term, and gate the densitometric readout on it — a quantity their pipeline never produces and could not produce, since its degradation model is fixed.

differentiation_from_lit.venue_year: International Conference on Medical Image Computing and Computer-Assisted Intervention 2022
differentiation_from_lit.delta: They establish that models trained on simulated degradation transfer poorly to real thick series and measure that gap in PSNR/SSIM; we attribute the gap to a specific, separately-measurable pair of quantities (a fitted effective width that differs from the nominal one, and a mean-direction displacement of the reconstruction) and show the endpoint consequence on emphysema densitometry rather than on image similarity.

They infer image and measurement operator jointly under one generative objective, so operator error and prior error remain entangled in a single posterior; we deliberately keep the estimands in separate solvers and project the resulting residual onto the direction that moves a threshold functional, which is what makes the attribution — and therefore the refusal to report — possible.

They absorb forward-model mismatch into an untrained per-instance correction network, leaving the mismatch unnamed; we identify it as two reportable physical quantities (effective slice width, unexplained residual fraction) and use them as an inference-time gate rather than as capacity.

They harmonise reconstruction kernels to a reference setting so that emphysema extent correlates better with clinical parameters, which requires the reference protocol to exist; we estimate the acquisition per scan from the series itself and never require a reference protocol, and we address slice thickness, which kernel conversion leaves untouched.

They bound how much, where and how stably a restoration may edit its input in the image domain; we bound and report the induced error of the FUNCTIONAL that is actually read (a threshold count on the attenuation histogram), which an image-domain bound neither implies nor detects, since a small diffuse offset is admissible under their bound and decisive for ours.

Their agents select restoration tools and their order from experience, so the quantity they emit is a plan whose value can only be judged by the restored image; ours emit a physical quantity with a checkable invariance — the displacement term is flat to 0.04 HU across operator widths of 4-10 mm on a real pair, whereas any tool-selection signal necessarily moves with the acquisition assumption it never estimates, so the two are separable by the width-sweep ablation rather than only by positioning.

They regress volume, noise and inter-scanner bias out of a lung-density summary after the fact; we produce the volume itself together with evidence about whether its histogram is supported by the measurement, so the correction is auditable per scan rather than fitted across a cohort.

reviewer_concerns_and_responses.attack: Paper-pointed threat: arxiv:2503.21501v1 (lit_table). Double Blind Imaging with Generative Modeling infers the image and the measurement operator jointly under a generative prior over operators, which is the strongest existing claim on the same territory: if a reader accepts that a joint posterior over (operator, image) already tells you when a reconstruction is unsupported by the measurement, the candidate's separation of estimands looks like an implementation detail. The candidate stands because the joint posterior produces no statement about a DOWNSTREAM FUNCTIONAL — it can trade an operator error against an image offset with no observable signature, whereas the candidate's claim is precisely that one direction of the residual (the slab-mean direction) is invariant to the operator estimate and therefore isolates the displacement that moves a threshold count. That is a construction their formulation does not contain, and it is what makes a per-scan verdict possible. The threat is real but not subsuming: it would become subsuming if their operator prior were shown to make the mean-direction ambiguity vanish, which their paper neither claims nor tests.
reviewer_concerns_and_responses.response: The defense is anchored in core_mechanism and in the differentiation_from_lit entry for arxiv:2503.21501v1: a joint posterior over (operator, image) can trade an operator error against a global image offset with no observable signature, whereas the mechanism's claim is that ONE direction of the residual — the slab-mean direction — is invariant to the operator estimate and therefore isolates exactly the offset that moves a threshold count. The Phase 3.2 audit reached the same conclusion (addressable_via = not_needed): the threat becomes subsuming only if that mean-direction ambiguity is shown to vanish under their operator prior, which their paper neither claims nor tests, and the width-sweep ablation in method_flow.steps S10 is what would expose it if it did.

reviewer_concerns_and_responses.attack: Un-retrieved mechanism family flagged by the audit (parametric knowledge, not in the retrieved pool): Model-misspecification diagnostics for inverse problems / simulation-based inference — a statistics family the retrieval pool only grazed (the alias channel returned generic 'tests for model misspecification in simulation-based inference' hits). Scoop-check vocabulary before investing: 'misspecification diagnostics posterior predictive residual' and 'goodness-of-fit test for measurement operator'. — novelty vs this family is UNVERIFIED; run a targeted scoop-check on that vocabulary before investing.
reviewer_concerns_and_responses.response: A scoop-check on model-misspecification diagnostics for inverse problems and simulation-based inference must establish that no existing goodness-of-fit or posterior-predictive residual test already supplies a per-instance statistic that is provably invariant to the estimated forward operator AND tied to a downstream functional of the recovered signal; if one does, the contribution narrows to its instantiation for through-plane CT densitometry. This check has not been run yet and is not claimed to have passed.

reviewer_concerns_and_responses.attack: Gap-closure reject-check borderline on gap 1 (C25 (Decompose and Delegate to Solvers)): Re-deriving a routing move that a closely neighboring published system already demonstrated, while showing only marginal gains, fails the novelty bar regardless of engineering polish.; A self-improvement or decomposition loop whose reliability hinges on an unvalidated data-generation, retrieval, or filtering component invites rejection when error propagation across iterations is nev
reviewer_concerns_and_responses.response: The distinction from agentic imaging systems is made testable rather than positional in differentiation_from_lit: their artifact is a plan judged by the restored image, while ours is a physical quantity with a checkable invariance — the displacement term is flat to 0.04 HU across operator widths of 4-10 mm on a real pair, whereas any tool-selection signal moves with the acquisition assumption it never estimates. method_flow.steps S10's width sweep is the experiment that separates them.

reviewer_concerns_and_responses.attack: Gap-closure reject-check borderline on gap 2 (C05 (Audit and Pivot an Assumption)): Advertising an identifiability or 'consistency' property while the proof omits the decisive object — never proving latent identifiability, or excluding part of the model from the guarantee — collapses
reviewer_concerns_and_responses.response: The identifiability claim is stated at conditional strength in core_mechanism, with its conditions named (eroded interior support, normalised kernel, replicate padding) and its measured bias floor quoted (-0.55 HU on a real pair) rather than asserted as exact. Crucially the condition is both ENFORCED by the estimator (the erosion is part of the definition) and VERIFIED before any model claim by step S6, which runs the certificate on a known-perfect reconstruction — the theory-practice disconnect this reject lesson describes is what that step exists to prevent.

reviewer_concerns_and_responses.attack: Gap-closure reject-check borderline on gap 3 (C07 (Manufacture the Supervisory Signal)): A label-free signal whose validity depends on model calibration silently fails on exactly the deep networks known to be poorly calibrated — validate a surrogate where its core assumption is weakest, n
reviewer_concerns_and_responses.response: The manufactured signal is split by validity: the displacement term depends on no calibration property of the network and is validated exactly where its assumption is weakest (a perfect reconstruction, across the full operator range), while the tail-recovery term was found by the coherence gate's executed dry run to rest on a stationarity premise that fails by an order of magnitude on real data. Rather than keep it as a derived identity, core_mechanism now states it as a protocol-calibrated empirical relation with a held-out residual spread, an explicit non-transfer warning, and an UNAVAILABLE state when no calibration exists — and it is never used as a training loss, so the degenerate solution of injecting noise cannot be reached.
